# @vllnt/convex-invitations

> TypeScript Convex component for single-use, expiring invitation links: issue, accept once, revoke, expire and prune invites.

Install `@vllnt/convex-invitations` (unreleased builds from `main` use the `canary` dist-tag). Peer
dependency `convex@^1.45.0`; Node.js as convex requires (`>=20.0.0` for convex 1.45 to 1.48,
`>=22.0.0` for 1.49 and newer). Mount it with `app.use(invitations)` from
`@vllnt/convex-invitations/convex.config` and call it through `new Invitations(components.invitations)`
from host mutations and queries. Methods: `issue`, `accept`, `revoke`, `peek`, `getByToken`,
`listPending`, `listByResourceState`, `migrateLegacyTokens`, `prune`. Lifecycle: `pending` ->
`accepted` | `revoked` | `expired`; terminal states never change, so a replayed link never grants
twice. `issue` returns the raw token once and stores only its SHA-256 digest; list queries return no
token. `accept` returns `{ resourceRef, role?, payload? }` and writes nothing in host tables: apply
the grant in the same host mutation. `inviteeRef` is not enforced. `getByToken` and the lists report
the stored state, so a past-TTL invite can read `pending` until `peek` or the daily prune cron stores
`expired`. Errors are `ConvexError` with `data.code` `INVALID_TOKEN`, `INVALID_ARGUMENT`,
`INVALID_BATCH`, `DUPLICATE_TOKEN`, `NOT_FOUND`, `EXPIRED`, `ALREADY_ACCEPTED`, `ALREADY_REVOKED` or
`ALREADY_EXPIRED`. Tokens are 1 to 512 characters. Default TTL 7 days; terminal invites are deleted
30 days after `createdAt`; `prune` batch 1 to 500 (default 200), `migrateLegacyTokens` batch 1 to 100
(default 50). The host owns auth, delivery and the meaning of `resourceRef`, `role` and `payload`;
there is no React entry.

## When to use

- Use it when someone joins an org, team or workspace through a link that works once and expires.
- Use it when an open invite must be revocable and a replayed or concurrent accept must never grant
  twice.
- Do not use it when you need sign-in links, password resets or user accounts: use
  `@convex-dev/auth`.
- Do not use it when you need the invite email sent: it returns the token and sends nothing; use
  `@convex-dev/resend` or your own mailer.

## For coding agents

The docs are bundled in the package at `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-invitations/docs/` and match the
installed version. Read them, and the shipped `src/`, before writing code. The links below to `./`
paths are files inside the installed package.
